title: Cleaning and inspection
price: Complimentary for our pieces. $35 for others.
detail: Ultrasonic and steam cleaning, a prong check under the microscope and a polish of the band. We recommend it every six months for a ring you wear daily.

title: Resizing
detail: Up or down by up to two sizes on most rings. Eternity and some pavé bands cannot be resized, and we will say so before we start. First resize free within a year on pieces we made.

title: Repair and restoration
price: Prong retipping from $60 per prong. Quoted after inspection.
detail: Retipping, rebuilding worn shanks, replacing lost melee, re-rhodium plating for white gold and restoring engraving. We quote in writing before any work begins.

title: Insurance appraisal
price: $150 for the first piece, $75 each additional
turnaround: 2 business days, or same day by appointment
detail: A written appraisal for insurance replacement value with measurements, photographs and stone grades. Prepared by our gemologist in house. We price it per piece, never as a percentage of value.

title: Heirloom redesign
price: Book a consultation. Retainer credited to the work.
detail: Reuse a family stone or metal in a new design. We test and grade your stones first and tell you honestly what can be reused safely.
